== Description ==

[[Steve Harpster]] (left, white hair, glasses, black zip jacket, orange sleeves), [[Brandon Baity]] (front right (back/side), olive zip hoodie over beige collar, brown beard), and [[Jack Douglass]] (background right, blue beaver-logo tee, watch) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
